selection.description: The exact first 100 images in the aesthetic-ranked v1 gallery view accepted by the human reviewer as the founding-canon iteration pool.

promptInvariants: Preserve the reference image's strongest composition, palette, atmosphere, scale, and original visual identity while producing a clearly new frame. Context Landscape original universe. No readable text, pseudo-text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, branded insignia, existing franchise designs, decorative user-interface frames, or unexplained humanoid anatomy.

subjectCorrections.mech-scout: Make the chassis mechanically unambiguous: exactly three load-bearing articulated legs in a radial tripod arrangement, all three legs visible and connected to one compact sensor body; no humanoid arms, hands, or hidden fourth limb. It must read instantly as a fast reconnaissance machine.
subjectCorrections.mech-line: Keep a balanced bipedal line chassis with exactly two legs and two restrained utility arms, medium armor, relay equipment, and a stable front-holding silhouette; avoid both scout fragility and siege bulk.
subjectCorrections.mech-siege: Increase the low, broad, weight-bearing silhouette, planted stabilizers, layered armor, and command uplink while keeping weaponry subordinate to its role as an objective anchor.
subjectCorrections.ability-overclock: Show one mech converting a dangerous but controlled power surge into faster actuator motion and newly affordable action capacity; make routed energy, cost, and precision legible without generic explosion imagery.
subjectCorrections.ability-macro-flare: Show one bounded rectangular battlefield volume revealing several distinct artifact contacts across exactly two signal emissions; retain clear top-down spatial geometry and avoid a generic radial blast.
subjectCorrections.artillery-desperation-he: Keep a top-down 10-by-10 tactical field and show the losing commander's own dense unverified artifact cluster being force-resolved by HE: some fragments visibly resolve as accepted signals and others as rejected drift, with self-inflicted terminal risk legible in the scene.
subjectCorrections.battlefield-context-furnace: Make exactly three navigable lanes physically distinct: loaded context, an overheated active session, and a cool clean replacement route. Show a nearly complete objective beside imminent thermal collapse so the command tradeoff reads from the terrain alone.
subjectCorrections.battlefield-documentation-fortress: Make exactly three functional lanes physically distinct: orientation, decision record, and verification. Center durable artifact sockets; contrast one compact useful structure that compounds command efficiency against a sprawling stale archive that freezes movement.
subjectCorrections.commander-adaptive-siege-anchor: Keep the commander active rather than conventionally posed: show a two-scout plus one-siege formation around the command table, with the siege visibly anchored and triage allocation changing under pressure.
subjectCorrections.commander-scout-mobile-focus: Keep the commander active rather than conventionally posed: show exactly three line mechs moving as a coordinated mobile formation, one precise Perfect Focus target lock, sparse controls, and decisive forward command posture.
